geometry.fixed: Actual finite three-rectangle W/E sections, handedness, one-cell pitch, root and finite lowest lower-rail patch/ground clearance.
geometry.provenance: Monotonic-chain convex hull of XY projections of the measured source outer-hull vertices; vertical clearance uses the existing catalog worldHeight. This is an explicit root size budget before editing.
geometry.source3DHull: Retained as a measured source observation. Its sloping hardware-dependent planes are not an implicit collision law or a required copy of the old upper silhouette.
geometry.freedom: New native interior construction, upper proportions, decoration, part counts and use of blank bays may improve inside the finite XY/height budget. Original per-part boxes and sampled empty bays are observations. No geometry may reach Z0 or extend beyond this budget.

canonicalCollars.reason: Explicit .08 finite collars fit inside the measured uninterrupted .15 terminal intervals while leaving interior modeling freedom.
canonicalCollars.fields: Fresh middle may redesign native normal/material/albedo fields coherently. Actual shader-used fields and longitudinal derivatives must match under W/E translation. The exact approved result becomes a future family resource; source weak shading is not a lock.

sampling.rationale: Own unedited-source diagnostic: historical 1.5+LANCZOS repeats have interior alpha loss; direct narrow native2 removes those S samples and avoids separately averaging depth-facing cutface occlusion before composition.
sampling.limits: Connected-native and actual consumer evidence are still pending for a redesigned candidate. Three partial-alpha outer rivet pixels per E/W are retained, not repaired or counted as interior holes.

scope: No candidate, family, production or Godot approval; fixed target and independent visible outcomes retained.
